exterior_convention: finite zeros outside the footprint (all values finite)

projection_model.K_hat_source: identified from the verified subset contrasts GEMSDOE32 < GEMSDOE31 < GEMSDOE25 (see docs/data/subset-calibration.json)
projection_model.lambda_meaning: fraction of the holdout-measured kernel credit that carries over to the hidden off-catalogue truth; UNKNOWN, hence a band

exterior_convention_note: The repository's scripts/submission_writer.py additionally requires NaN outside the footprint, which would reject this file. Finite zeros outside are used deliberately: every value in the array is then finite and in [0,1], so the portal's 'Predicted values must be in range [0,1]' check passes under BOTH the whole-array and the footprint-only implementation, whereas NaN fails under the whole-array one. The two highest-scoring files in the focus family (GEMSDOE32 0.2778, GEMSDOE36 0.2750) both use zeros outside. Flagged as IR-EXTERIOR-01.
